Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the chase! The South African fielders are in the huddle before dispersing on the field. Kevin O'Brien and Paul Stirling to open the batting for the Irish. George Linde to start with the ball.

Right then! 166 is what Ireland need to win the first T20I. They have a good batting line up but the Proteas bowling line up is top class. The pitch is a touch slower so expect Tabraiz Shamsi and George Linde to play a big role. This should be an exciting chase. So don't go anywhere is we will be back for the chase in a bit.

Simi Singh is down for a chat, he says that anything under 170 on this ground is chaseable. Adds that he bowled the leg-spinner as he had an intuition that Markram will come down the track. Says that they need to get a good Powerplay and then take it from there to chase it.

Ireland were great with the ball from the start. Mark Adair took two wickets in the Powerplay and Simi Singh took one to rock the South African top order. In the middle overs, Simi Singh took another one and Josh Little took two big wickets to make sure that South Africa never broke free. They were on track to restrict Proteas to a low score but an expensive last over by Mark Adair let the tourists get past 160.

South Africa did not have the greatest of starts with the bat. Quinton de Kock got off to a flier but fell for 20. After that, Temba Bavuma and Janneman Malan fell soon and they were 3 down in the Powerplay. Aiden Markram and Rassie van der Dussen tried to stabilize things but the latter fell at the wrong time. Markram too fell while looking to up the ante in the last few overs. But some handy knocks by David Miller and Kagiso Rabada in the last few overs means that they have put on a decent score on the board.

17 runs in the last over and South Africa have the momentum going in the break. This is not the easiest pitch to bat on and Ireland will have to bat really well against a top-class bowling attack to win this.
Shorter ball, on leg. Pulled to deep square leg for one. South Africa end at 165 for 7!
Swing and a miss! Slower length ball, outside off. Rabada clears his front leg and looks to slog it but misses.
FOUR! Slower ball pitched short. Kagiso Rabada waits for it and pulls it towards square leg for his fourth boundary of the over. These are some valuable runs late in the innings for South Africa.
FOUR! Three in a row! Full ball on stumps. Kagiso Rabada drives it straight down the ground for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Two in a row! Full ball on the leg stump. Kagiso Rabada heaves it towards wide mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Low full toss outside off. Kagiso Rabada slices it over extra cover for a much-needed boundary.
Good length ball around off. Kagiso Rabada hoicks to deep mid-wicket for one. Mistimes it completely as the bat turns in his hands.
Good length ball on the pads. Lizaad Williams tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
In the blockhole now. Kagiso Rabada digs it out to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide. Kagiso Rabada slashes hard but misses the cut.
Good length ball on the pads. Lizaad Williams flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Lizaad Williams comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Miller departs! Little does it again! Good length ball around off stump. David Miller looks to slog it hard and edges it to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker takes an easy catch to send back the southpaw.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Yorker, on the pads. Miller clips it to the leg side for one.
Kagiso Rabada is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Change of pace does it again! Slower length ball, on off. Linde hits it high in the air towards long off. It went miles in the air, but Simi Singh settled under it, kept his eyes on the ball and did the rest!
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Just a single as this is pushed to long off by Miller.
Slower bouncer, on off. Linde misses his pull and gets hit on the body. They take a leg bye.
Full toss, outside off. Miller hits it straight to deep point for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to covers. They take the quick single and the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end.
Mark Adair is back on. He went for 17 and picked 2 wickets in his first two.
On the pads. Linde gets hit on the pads and they get a leg bye.
Nails the yorker on the pads. Miller whips it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Lovely touch! Slower shorter ball, outside off. Miller runs it past short third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Pure timing! On the pads and Miller whips it away. The fielders from deep mid-wicket and deep square leg converge but the ball pierces the gap and runs to the fence.
Back of a length, on off. Blocked towards point for one.
Shorter ball, down the leg side. Miller pulls it to fine leg for one.
Josh Little to bowl now. 2-0-12-1 so far.
Flatter on leg. David Miller flicks this one off the back foot for one.
Flatter on off. David Miller punches it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, on leg. George Linde plays the on drive for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Blocked out.
Tossed up, on leg. Driven to long on for a run by Miller.
Tossed up on middle. Flicked to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side. Wide called.
On the pads. Linde works it to the leg side for one.
Flatter ball, outside off. Punched to covers.
Flatter ball on off. George Linde blocks out this one.
Flatter ball on off. George Linde looks to push it to the off side and gets beaten.
FOUR! Boundary to get going! Shorter ball, outside off. Linde cuts it to third man fence.
George Linde walks out to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED! A wicket at the right time for the Irish! A surprise leg spinner from Simi Singh, pitched outside off. Aiden Markram steps down to slog this one over long on but misses it. Lorcan Tucker whips off the bails in a flash and a well-set batsman departs.
Commentary.Howout: st Lorcan Tucker b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Simi Singh to bowl out now. 3-0-14-1 are his figures so far.
Markram whips this off the pads. To deep mid-wicket for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Miller turns it to the leg side for one.
Darted on the pads. Miller plays it to the left of the bowler.
Just a single to long on now.
SIX! All the way! South Africa are changing gears now! Shorter ball, outside off. Aiden Markram hits it all the way over the mid-wicket fence.
Flatter ball, around off. Punched to sweeper cover. The fielder fumbles there and that allows the second.
Paul Stirling is back on. He went for 11 in his first over.
FOUR! Lovely work! Shorter ball, outside off. Third man is up so Miller opens the face of the bat and runs it past him for a boundary.
Slower length ball, outside off. Pushed to covers for one. 100 up for Proteas.
FOUR! And more! Full ball, on middle. Markam gets under it and powers it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! Shorter ball, on off. Markram pulls it to the mid-wicket fence.
Length ball, outside off. Miller whips it to the leg side for one.
Slower shorter ball, outside off. Cut away past point for one.
Barry McCarthy is back on. He went for 16 in his first two overs.
Tossed up ball on leg stump. Aiden Markram advances down the track and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker ball, on the pads. David Miller flicks it off the back foot for one towards deep mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, on middle. Aiden Markram pushes it to long on for one.
Flatter ball, on off. David Miller taps it to point for one.
Short ball, outside off. Aiden Markram smashes it to extra over fielder for one.
Flatter ball, on off. David Miller defends it to point for one.
Simi Singh (2-0-8-1) is back on.
Josh Little comes 'round the wicket and bowls a short ball on off. David Miller taps it to point for an easy single.
Length ball outside off. Aiden Markram hits it to the deep extra cover for a single.
Full ball on pads. David Miller flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller ball, outside off. Pushed to cover.
Sprays one down the leg side. Wide called.
David Miller comes to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Josh Little invites Rassie van der Dussen to drive the ball by pitching it full outside off. Rassie van der Dussen looks to drive it through covers but finds the cover fielder. Andy Balbirnie takes a simple catch. Another partnership is broken by Ireland. Josh Little is delighted and so he should be!
Commentary.Howout: c Andy Balbirnie b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Punished! Short and wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen cuts it hard past point for a boundary.
Josh Little is back on. He went for 4 in his first over.
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away past point for one.
SIX! Up and away! Rassie van der Dussen comes down the track and takes it on the full, he then extends his arms and hits it all the way over the wide long on fence.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Down the leg side and Rassie van der Dussen sends it racing to the fine leg fence.
Flatter ball, outside off. Pushed past covers for one.
Dances down the track and clips it to the leg side for one.
Markram comes down the track looking to heave it to the leg side. But gets the inside edge to square leg for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Markram pulls it to long on for one. Just the 4 singles from the over then.
A perfect yorker, on off. Blocked out.
Back of a length, outside off. Rassie van der Dussen gets the inside edge as he looks to drive. The ball goes past the stumps for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to long off for one.
Length ball, on off. Rassie van der Dussen gets inisde edge on the pads. The ball rolls towards the keeper and they get one.
Slower length ball, around off. Defended out.
Barry McCarthy is back on. He went for 12 in his first over.
LEG BYE! Flatter on the pads, Rassie van der Dussen steps down and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away to the mid-wicket region and they take one.
Flatter ball on off. Punched off the backfoot for one.
Short ball on leg. Aiden Markram misses the heave on the on side and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, driven hard to long off by Rassie van der Dussen. Another single.
Flatter ball on off. Aiden Markram drills it to long off for one.
Tossed up outside off. Driven to covers for one.
More spin! George Dockrell comes in the attack.
Too full outside off. Rassie van der Dussen slices it to the point fielder and that is a good diving stop there at point.
Off cutter, wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen drives it to cover awkwardly.
Length ball, on off. Aiden Markram punches this to deep extra cover for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Rassie van der Dussen pushes it to cover for one.
Josh Little comes 'round the wicket. Good length ball on the pads, turned towards deep square leg for one.
Full and wide outside off. Aiden Markram digs it out to point.
Josh Little comes in the attack now.
Flatter ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler. Powerplay is done and South Africa are 48 for 3! A good start for Ireland.
Shorter ball, on off. Markram clips it wide of long on for a couple.
Flatter ball, on off. Aiden Markram works it to long on for one.
Flatter ball, on off. Markram blocks it.
Just a single as this is eased to long on.
Rassie van der Dussen is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Oh dear, that is a poor stroke by the skipper. Fuller ball, outside off. Bavuma attempts the reverse sweep but only gets a feather on it. Lorcan Tucker takes it with ease behind the stumps. What a start for Ireland!
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Simi Singh

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Connects this one alright! Short ball, on the body. Markam rocks back and pulls it all the way over the square leg fence.
Slower ball, short in length and outside off. Markram misses his pull.
Cut him in half! Length ball, lands outside off and nips back in. Aiden Markram looks to defend but the ball goes through the gate.
Short ball, down the leg side. Markram misses his pull. Wide called.
Length ball, on middle. Markram gets hit on the pads as he misses his flick.
Aiden Markram walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! What a start this is for Ireland! Slower length ball, on middle. Malan looks to go down the ground but gets the inner half of the bat. Simi Singh moves to his right from mid on, he juggles the ball twice but takes the catch on the third attempt.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, outside off. Cut away to point.
Flighted ball outside off. Temba Bavuma pushes it to point. Good start this from Simi Singh .
Tossed up ball outside off. Temba Bavuma looks to heave it over mid-wicket but fails to connect well. The ball goes straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Tossed up ball on off. Janneman Malan pushes it to cover for a quick single.
Short ball, on off, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs by Malan.
Flatter ball, on stumps. Pushes it to long on for one does Temba Bavuma.
Loopy ball, on off, turned to short mid-wicket.
Simi Singh comes in the attack now.
Good length ball on off. Temba Bavuma taps it to point for an easy single.
Good length ball on off. Janneman Malan pushes it to the extra cover fielder for a run. And he is off the mark.
Janneman Malan walks out to bat.
OUT! CAUGHT! Big wicket! Good length ball on off. Quinton de Kock chips this one straight to mid off, where Paul Stirling takes a dolly. Big wicket this for Ireland.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball on middle. Driven to the mid off fielder by Quinton de Kock. Temba Bavuma slipped at the non-striker end so there was no run taken.
FOUR! Another one! Full ball outside off. Quinton de Kock outside edges it over the short third man fielder.
FOUR! Runs are coming thick and fast! Full ball on off, Quinton de Kock slices this over point for a boundary.
Mark Adair comes in the attack. Just the one over for Paul Stirling then.
Slower length ball, on the pads. Quinton de Kock clips it to mid on for one.
SIX! A conventional stroke! Length ball, around off. De Kock gets under it and hammers it over the wide long on fence.
Good length ball, on leg. Quinton de Kock shuffles across to scoop it but gets no bat on it.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! Short of a length, on off. De Kock pulls it to the mid-wicket fence.
Back of a length, outside off. Bavuma chops it to deep backward point for a single now.
Length ball, outside off. Bavuma punches it to covers.
Barry McCarthy to start from the other end.
Just a single as this is tapped to long on. 11 from the first over!
FOUR! Lovely stroke! Full ball, on off. Temba Bavuma drives it to the left of mid off for a boundary.
On the pads. Quinton de Kock tucks it to the leg side for one.
Fuller ball, on off. Pushed to covers for one.
FOUR! Up and running! This time, Temba Bavuma puts it away. Cuts this past the diving cover fielder and gets a boundary.
Weather - What lovely weather to play cricket. Nice and sunny, not too warm and not a cloud in sight!
Shorter ball, outside off. Cut away to covers.

Time for the national anthems! First, it is South Africa's anthem followed by Ireland's. The players now disperse on the field. Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock will open for Proteas. Paul Stirling to open the bowling. The players first take the knee to protest racial discrimination.

Temba Bavuma says that they are not too disappointed to bat first. Adds that they don't take anything for granted and Ireland are quite smart. Adds that they will take the momentum from the West Indies series in this tour. Finishes by saying that they will assess what kind of total should be ideal but they will look to score at least 180.
Andy Balbirnie says that it is a small ground and he backs his batters to chase down a target. Adds that a big year of T20 cricket coming and it is a great way to get started.
Ireland (Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (C), Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Harry Tector, George Dockrell, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Shane Getkate, Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Josh Little.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Temba Bavuma (C), Janneman Malan, Aiden Markram, Rassie van der Dussen, David Miller, George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Lizaad Williams, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Toss - The coin lands in favour of Ireland and they will bowl first!

Hello and a warm welcome to the first T20I between Ireland and South Africa. I mean that quite literally as this is the first time that these two teams are facing off in the shortest format of the game. Both these teams are coming off of a drawn ODI series in which Ireland beat South Africa for the first time in ODIs. But South Africa won their recent T20 series against West Indies and in the last ODI, showed their strength. It's the T20 format, so making the prediction about who will win is a risky bet. Will we see the Irish upset the Proteas or will South Africa walk over the hosts? We will find out. Toss and teams in a bit.
